messages:
Aisha Malik: Quick scheduling q — candidate prefers late afternoon IST on Tue (Apr 28). We currently have panelers in PST/EDT. Proposed slots:
- Tue 10:00 AM PST / Tue 1:00 PM EST (works for west coast)
- Tue 6:00 PM UTC / Tue 11:30 PM IST (not great)
Can folks check availability? Also: candidate did the take-home; we need to confirm debrief lead and whether we treat the take-home as 50% of score.

Mateo Chen: 10am PST works for me. Prefer not to record. Can be debrief backup if needed.

Priya Singh: I can do 10am PST but only if we keep the interview to 60m. Agree we should weight take-home, but maybe 40/40/20: Take-home 40, System design 40, Communication 20.

Lucas Ortega: I can lead the debrief. I'm ok with 10am PST. Suggest we standardize anchor Qs for take-home to keep evals comparable. Example anchor prompts:
```
- What trade-offs did they make?
- How well does the code handle edge cases?
- Would you pair with them on this code?
```

Aisha Malik: Thanks — Lucas, can you add the anchor Qs to the eval form and take debrief lead? Priya, noted on 60m cap. Mateo — thanks for backup.
